label: Peplink MAX BR2 Pro 5G
description: Mobile router with 5G: 1x 2.5G WAN, 1x GE WAN, 4x GE LAN, 1 Gbps throughput, Wi-Fi, PoE in.
notes: Vendor figures from the Peplink tech-spec sheet: Ethernet WAN port **2 / 1 (2.5G)**, LAN port **4 / 5 (GE)**, Router Throughput 1 Gbps, Wi-Fi AP Yes, **PoE Input Yes**. The slash matters: WAN port 1 can act as a LAN port, so the same box is either 2 WAN / 4 LAN or 1 WAN / 5 LAN. Modelled as the 2 WAN configuration with the first WAN at 2.5G, because that is the port people buy it for.
